action.name: generation_report
action.content: SELECT iso_code,year,electricity_generation AS generation_twh FROM energy WHERE (iso_code='DNK' OR iso_code='FIN') AND year>=2019 AND year<=2022 AND electricity_generation IS NOT NULL ORDER BY iso_code,year

action.name: window_summary
action.content: SELECT iso_code,count(electricity_generation) AS measured_years,coalesce(sum(electricity_generation),0) AS total_twh FROM energy WHERE (iso_code='DNK' OR iso_code='FIN') AND year>=2019 AND year<=2022 GROUP BY iso_code ORDER BY iso_code

action.name: coverage_report
action.content: SELECT iso_code,count(year) AS observed_years,count(electricity_generation) AS measured_years,sum(CASE WHEN electricity_generation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_years FROM energy WHERE (iso_code='DNK' OR iso_code='FIN') AND year>=2019 AND year<=2022 GROUP BY iso_code ORDER BY iso_code

action.name: exclusions
action.content: SELECT iso_code,year,CASE WHEN iso_code!='DNK' AND iso_code!='FIN' THEN 'country' WHEN year<2019 OR year>2022 THEN 'year' ELSE 'missing' END AS reason FROM energy WHERE iso_code!='DNK' AND iso_code!='FIN' OR year<2019 OR year>2022 OR electricity_generation IS NULL ORDER BY iso_code,year

action.name: field_contract
action.content: SELECT 'generation_twh' AS field_name,'TWh' AS unit,'omitted' AS null_policy,'observed_years_sum' AS aggregation
